about: EXACT-1: exact descriptions of the N = 12 critical configurations found so far (not a completeness claim). Exact values are strings: integers, rationals p/q, and elements of K = Q[t]/(P) as coefficient lists in 1, t, ..., t^(d-1), constant term first. Floats are labelled and decide nothing. "Exactly verified" = an exact computation in K accepted every listed identity and inequality; this is not the completeness checker.
